response.text: That last query returned too much. I'll check a few more details: the payment-to-journal linkage, dates versus periods, and the user names on GL entries.

arguments.sql:
SELECT 'gl_users' k, "SRC_REF" a, count(*)::text b FROM "GLJRNH" WHERE "SRC_CD"='GL' GROUP BY 2 UNION ALL
SELECT 'gl_memos', "MEMO", count(*)::text FROM "GLJRNH" WHERE "SRC_CD"='GL' GROUP BY 2 UNION ALL
SELECT 'post_outside_period', count(*)::text, '' FROM "GLJRNH" h JOIN "GLPERD" p USING("PRD_ID") WHERE h."POST_DT" NOT BETWEEN p."STRT_DT" AND p."END_DT" UNION ALL
SELECT 'post_in_closed_after_close', count(*)::text, '' FROM "GLJRNH" h JOIN "GLPERD" p USING("PRD_ID") WHERE p."CLOSE_DT" IS NOT NULL AND h."POST_DT" > p."CLOSE_DT" UNION ALL
SELECT 'pay_hdr_matches_srcref', count(*)::text, '' FROM "GLJRNH" h WHERE h."SRC_REF" LIKE 'PAY-%' UNION ALL
SELECT 'srcref_leading_space', count(*)::text, '' FROM "GLJRNH" WHERE "SRC_REF" <> trim("SRC_REF") UNION ALL
SELECT 'paid_inv_without_pay', count(*)::text, '' FROM "APINVH" i WHERE "STAT_CD"='P' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "APPAYM" p WHERE p."INV_ID"=i."INV_ID") UNION ALL
SELECT 'open_inv_with_pay', count(*)::text, '' FROM "APINVH" i WHERE "STAT_CD"='O' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "APPAYM" p WHERE p."INV_ID"=i."INV_ID") UNION ALL
SELECT 'pay_amt_ne_inv', count(*)::text, '' FROM "APPAYM" p JOIN "APINVH" i USING("INV_ID") WHERE p."PAY_AMT"<>i."INV_AMT" UNION ALL
SELECT 'multi_pay_inv', count(*)::text, '' FROM (SELECT 1 FROM "APPAYM" GROUP BY "INV_ID" HAVING count(*)>1) x UNION ALL
SELECT 'pay_before_inv', count(*)::text, '' FROM "APPAYM" p JOIN "APINVH" i USING("INV_ID") WHERE p."PAY_DT"<i."INV_DT" UNION ALL
SELECT 'inv_hdr_dt_mismatch', count(*)::text, '' FROM "APINVH" i JOIN "GLJRNH" h USING("JRNL_NO") WHERE h."POST_DT"<>i."INV_DT" UNION ALL
SELECT 'inv_jrnl_not_AP', count(*)::text, '' FROM "APINVH" i JOIN "GLJRNH" h USING("JRNL_NO") WHERE h."SRC_CD"<>'AP' UNION ALL
SELECT 'dates_range', min("INV_DT")::text, max("INV_DT")::text FROM "APINVH" UNION ALL
SELECT 'jrnl_no_range', min("JRNL_NO")::text, max("JRNL_NO")::text FROM "GLJRNH" UNION ALL
SELECT 'inv_ge_open_period_jrnl_closed', count(*)::text, '' FROM "GLJRNH" h JOIN "GLPERD" p USING("PRD_ID") WHERE p."STAT_CD"='C' AND h."JRNL_NO">2400
SELECT l.*, h."SRC_REF", h."MEMO", h."POST_DT" FROM "GLJRNL" l JOIN "GLJRNH" h USING("JRNL_NO") WHERE l."ACCT_CD"='5900' OR l."JRNL_NO" IN (2491, 1406, 1000) ORDER BY 1,2
